annotations.title: Prediction market search: Polymarket odds for any event by keyword

description: Search Polymarket prediction markets by keyword (election, bitcoin, fed, world cup) and get the matching open markets with outcome odds as implied probabilities, best bid and ask, volume, liquidity, end date and token ids. Use to look up the odds on an event, find a market before reading its order book, or feed a forecasting agent. Example: q=bitcoin. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

closed.description: true for resolved or closed markets instead of open ones

q.description: Search words, e.g. bitcoin, election, fed rates
